{{Quote|It will only be a matter of time before either the droids or my own&hellip; correction, Grey Squad tracks me down.|Grey Squad's Jedi Knight|<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" />}}
'''Grey Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" /> nine [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served in one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]]<ref name="Squads" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Stationed on the<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Mustafar">{{DB|location|mustafar|Mustafar}}</ref> [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] towards the end of the war, Grey Squad was led by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Mustafar)|Jedi Knight]],<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" /> a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]], and a [[Corporal/Legends|clone trooper corporal]].<ref name="Leadership" /> 

Following the<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" /> activation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Grey Squad turned on their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leader and attempted to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunt him down]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] managed to elude Grey Squad's search, but wrote in a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that it was only a matter of [[Time/Legends|time]] until the squad caught up to [[Gender/Legends|him]]. Preparing for the squad's eventual arrival, he hid most of his personal belongings in a chest for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to find. The datapad describing Grey Squad's actions was later found by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] among the stolen goods of a [[Salvage Bandit Camp|bandit camp]] on Mustafar around<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" /> [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Galaxies date">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]'' establishes that the [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] was over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old. Since the datapad's entries described the events of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'' dates as having happened in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the datapad's discovery must have happened around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grey Squad was mentioned in "The Jedi's Guard Dog" quest from the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] expansion for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], a massively multiplier online [[roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="SWG: Trials of Obi Wan" /> on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG BTS">[[Star Wars Galaxies Memory Book|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Memory Book]]</ref>
